preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The length of each string S must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in S)
preconditions.description: Each string S must contain only the characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of equivalence classes of substrings of the given string S.
